target.role: fresh whole-journey belonging and placement discovery for STRANGE GAIT
target.position: Whole journey: before the opener, between every non-protected pair, or after the tail. Preserve only Transparency → When We Froze and When We Froze → Stardancer; Truth in Noise → Transparency remains available.
target.purpose: Test one current adjacent structural turn and four overlooked rhythmic or structural constructions. Character changes are allowed; admission still requires purposeful transition, local-run and long-form effect.

sourceWindows: CURRENT ADJACENT / MEXICAN SUMMER: https://ra.co/reviews/36363 and https://fauzia.bandcamp.com/album/i-was-here-for-a-moment — all four July 2026 tracks were screened. FAUZIA — I can be anything was retained from exact-track accounts of a drum-led form redirected by guitar; the release's pop framing is not a rejection by itself.

CURRENT / RA AND BANDCAMP INDEXES: https://ra.co/reviews and https://daily.bandcamp.com/best-electronic — current July–September 2026 review and discovery windows were screened. RHR, Picture, Reptant, Batu & Donato Dozzy, Kelela and other Run 60–75 lanes were excluded as already inspected; newer label pages without exact-track behavior were not promoted.

OVERLOOKED CATALOGUE / HAUS OF ALTR: https://ra.co/reviews/33722 and https://acemomabk.bandcamp.com/ — all twelve A Future tracks were screened. AceMoMA — 1 Million Breaks was retained from the exact review's advancing and backwards-lurching percussion clusters.

OVERLOOKED ADJACENT / R&S: https://ra.co/reviews/22853 and https://djrum.bandcamp.com/album/portrait-with-firewood — all nine Portrait With Firewood tracks were screened. Djrum — Sex was retained from the exact review's broken-beat-techno form softening halfway into piano, cello and vocals.

OVERLOOKED CATALOGUE / ARA: https://ra.co/reviews/34936 and https://kangdingray.bandcamp.com/track/antiblau — all ten ULTRACHROMA tracks were screened. Kangding Ray — Antiblau was retained from the exact review's juddering drums and shuffly broken beat.

OVERLOOKED CATALOGUE / CHAIN REACTION–KEPLAR: https://ra.co/reviews/24869 and https://vladislavdelay.bandcamp.com/album/multila-2020-remaster — all seven Multila tracks were screened. Vladislav Delay — Huone (2020 Remaster) was retained from the exact review's crooked minimal-techno opening, polyrhythmic labyrinth and sparse midsection before kick re-entry.

ADDITIONAL WINDOWS: DJ Sotofett's Percussion Mixes Vol. 1, the Italian Flowers From The Ashes compilation, Djax-Re-Up, Ploy's It's Later Than You Think and FAUZIA/Kelela adjacent reviews were screened. Version ambiguity, collection-level evidence or weaker exact-track placement hypotheses kept them below the ranked list.
explorationReceipt.approximateInspectedScope: Approximately 44 named tracks and releases across current releases, adjacent/emerging artists and labels, and overlooked catalogue windows; metadata and attributed descriptions only, with zero audio auditions.
exclusions: All 14 canonical identities, active placement-specific rejects and every untriggered PARKED revisit were excluded. Exact identities and primary discovery lanes retained in Runs 53–75 were not recycled.
The protected internal handoffs Transparency → When We Froze and When We Froze → Stardancer remain unavailable; Truth in Noise → Transparency and every other boundary remain available.
No lead was promoted for recency, reputation, genre, novelty, title or technical cleverness. Release-level claims were not converted into exact-track behavior.

Energy, density, space, hypnosis, emotional effect, phrase structure, harmonic relation, perceived pulse and mixability remain unknown. Descriptions of metre, syncopation and transformation are evidence, not flow verdicts.
rankedLeadSummary: 1. Djrum — Sex: strongest complete internal transformation, moving from broken-beat techno into piano, cello and vocals halfway through.
2. Vladislav Delay — Huone (2020 Remaster): strongest long-form structural lead, documented as crooked minimal techno opening into a polyrhythmic labyrinth before a kick-guided final half.
3. AceMoMA — 1 Million Breaks: strongest overlooked percussion lead, with clusters that advance and lurch backwards.
4. Kangding Ray — Antiblau: strongest overlooked broken-techno lead, documented through juddering drums and a shuffly broken beat.
5. FAUZIA — I can be anything: strongest current adjacent turn, with a drum-and-sub framework redirected by guitar.
